summary: Seeking Alpha previews the peak earnings week of October 23 to 27, 2023, led by mega-cap tech (Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon) and including automakers, defense, energy, consumer staples and airlines. For each featured company it gives the reporting day, consensus EPS and revenue estimates, analyst and Seeking Alpha Quant ratings, and recent beat history. It also notes context such as Microsoft's Activision Blizzard deal, Boeing's 737 MAX bulkhead issue and rising oil prices.
one_line: Seeking Alpha previews the October 23-27, 2023 earnings week, with consensus estimates and ratings for Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, Boeing, Chevron, Exxon and others.
key_facts: Cleveland-Cliffs reports Q3 results Monday, October 23 after close; consensus EPS $0.44 and revenue $5.53B; Seeking Alpha Quant rating is Hold.
Alphabet reports Q3 on Tuesday, October 24 after market close; consensus EPS $1.45, revenue $75.73B; the stock is up 55% this year versus 12% for the S&P 500.
Seeking Alpha's Quant Rating moved Alphabet from Strong Buy to Hold days before earnings, while Wall Street analysts kept a Strong Buy.
Microsoft reports Tuesday after the close with consensus EPS $2.65 and revenue $54.54B; it has beaten EPS in 7 of the last 8 quarters.
Microsoft completed its $69B acquisition of Activision Blizzard, the largest deal in video game history, but its benefits won't show in this report.
Meta reports Wednesday, October 25 after the close; it guided Q3 revenue of $32B-$34.5B; consensus EPS $3.60, revenue $33.43B; stock is up about 150% this year.
Boeing reports Wednesday after the close with consensus EPS of $-2.53 and revenue of $18.37B; shares are down over 7% in six months.
Boeing and Spirit AeroSystems found erroneously drilled fastening holes in the aft pressure bulkhead on many 737 MAX planes; CFO Brian West said 75% of 220 inventory planes (165) are affected.
Boeing delivered 27 commercial jets in September, bringing its yearly total to 371, and aims to raise 787 production from three to four per month by end of 2023.
Amazon reports Q3 Thursday, October 26 after the close; consensus EPS $0.60, revenue $141.621B; shares are up almost 50% year to date and Quant rating is Hold.
Chevron and Exxon Mobil report Friday, October 27 before the open; both have Hold Quant ratings and Buy ratings from Wall Street; analysts expect Y/Y growth for CVX and a decline for XOM.
Ford, Intel, Mastercard, Southwest Airlines, Northrop Grumman and L3Harris are among companies reporting Thursday.
